author: andrewgcodes
name: Optimized Architecture v5
blurb: SP-1024 10x512 KV4 with optimized bigram (2048x64), MLP 3x, SWA (every 50 steps), RoPE, Muon weight decay (0.08), 10-layer architecture with Int5 MLP quantization, test-time training adaptation (3 epochs SGD, freeze 5 layers), sliding window eval (stride=64), and int8+zlib roundtrip.
